column1: Warning
<space-director> warned you to not shoot the moon.
<space-director> told you to not disgrace the agency any further, or there'll be consequences.
<space-director> warned you to come back down to Earth.
<space-director> warned you to behave yourself.
<space-director> warned you to not fly too close to the Sun.
<space-director> told you <he/she> isn't afraid to let the creatures in Area 51 have their way with you.
<space-director> told you to watch yourself, because <his/her> forgiveness only comes once in a blue moon.
<space-director> asked if you're from another planet, because you don't seem to understand how things work on Earth.
<space-director> looked at you, shook <his/her> head, and muttered, 'Houston, we have a problem'.
<space-director> warned you that acting responsibly shouldn't feel like rocket science.
<space-director> warned you that your opportunity to boldly go is about to swiftly leave.
<space-director> warned you <he/she> is about to ship you on a one-way trip to <Mars/Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Mercury/Venus/a black hole>.
<space-director> encouraged you to reach for the stars.
<space-director> told you to take your role more seriously.
<space-director> warned you that your star is about to supernova.
<space-director> warned you against continuing to act sus.
<space-director> told you to shape up, or you'll soon be shipping out for good.
<space-director> told you judging by the way you're acting, <he/she> thinks you might not be that bright.
<space-director> warned you that your future might not be a bright one if you keep acting up.
<space-director> encouraged you to set your sights for yourself a bit higher.
<space-director> warned you <he/she> won't let you off so easy in the future.
<space-director> told you to be grateful <he/she> is only giving you a warning.
<space-director> told you not to cause your own career to go the way of SpaceX's Starship rocket.
